# SD18 deterministic Human Druid level 14 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid
# level-1..level-13 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_druid_level13_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 14 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-13 fixtures, and the
# same canonical nature-bond selection (animal companion), adding only the
# level bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Druid burden surface: no animal
# companion stat block/advancement/link-share-spells, no Wild Shape
# execution (form list, duration tracking), no spellbook, no spells
# prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, and no level-15+ progression.
# Base attack bonus genuinely rises to +10 (14 * 3 / 4 = 10) and both good
# saves (Fortitude, Will) genuinely rise to +9 (14 / 2 + 2 = 9), while poor
# Reflex stays +4 (14 / 3 = 4, an integer-division coincidence with level
# 13), checked rather than assumed. Wild Empathy genuinely rises to 15
# (14 + Charisma modifier 1). The PF1 CRB Druid class table's level-14
# "Special" column reads "Wild shape (6/day)" (verified independently
# against d20pfsrd and Archives of Nethys aonprd.com): per the
# level-4/6/8/10/12 precedent, this frequency increase is bundled with a
# non-separable functioning-level upgrade, so Wild Shape stays entirely
# named-but-unproven and this slice grounds no new pillar at level 14
# either — only the existing arithmetic pillars are widened.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-druid-level14
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:druid:14
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:12
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:druid_nature_bond:bond:animal_companion
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
